$comment: Heuristics and oracles a charter may name. Sources: James Bach's Heuristic Test Strategy Model (SFDPOT), Elisabeth Hendrickson's Test Heuristics Cheat Sheet and Explore It!, Michael Bolton's FEW HICCUPPS oracles. ids are what charters cite.

sfdpot.structure.name: Structure
sfdpot.structure.prompt: What the product is made of: components, files, screens, the code that changed.

sfdpot.function.name: Function
sfdpot.function.prompt: What it does: each feature, calculation, error path.

sfdpot.data.name: Data
sfdpot.data.prompt: What it processes: inputs, outputs, stored state, boundaries, formats.

sfdpot.platform.name: Platform
sfdpot.platform.prompt: What it depends on: browsers, devices, OS, services, configuration.

sfdpot.operations.name: Operations
sfdpot.operations.prompt: How it is used: real workflows, personas, frequency, misuse.

sfdpot.time.name: Time
sfdpot.time.prompt: Timing: concurrency, timeouts, dates, ordering, slow and fast actions.

zero_one_many.name: Zero, one, many
zero_one_many.prompt: No items, exactly one, lots of them.

crud.name: CRUD
crud.prompt: Create, read, update and delete every kind of record, in every order.

interruptions.name: Interruptions
interruptions.prompt: Log out, close the tab, lose the network, go back, time out in the middle of a task.

goldilocks.name: Goldilocks
goldilocks.prompt: Too big, too small, just right: values at and across each limit.

starve.name: Starve
starve.prompt: Run short of a resource: balance, stock, disk, memory, rate limit.

follow_the_data.name: Follow the data
follow_the_data.prompt: Trace one value from entry through every screen, report and integration it reaches.

sequence_variations.name: Sequence variations
sequence_variations.prompt: Do the steps in a different order, twice, or concurrently in two tabs.

some_none_all.name: Some, none, all
some_none_all.prompt: Select some, none or all of a set; apply to a partial set.

beginning_middle_end.name: Beginning, middle, end
beginning_middle_end.prompt: Act at the start, middle and end of a list, a period or a flow.

familiar_problems.name: Familiar problems
familiar_problems.prompt: It shouldn't repeat a known bug or a problem of similar products.

explainability.name: Explainability
explainability.prompt: Its behaviour should be explainable to a user.

world.name: World
world.prompt: It should be consistent with how things work in the world.

image.name: Image
image.prompt: Consistent with the image the organisation wants.

claims.name: Claims
claims.prompt: Consistent with what the ticket, docs and marketing say.

user_expectations.name: User expectations
user_expectations.prompt: Consistent with what a reasonable user expects.

product.name: Product
product.prompt: Consistent with itself: same thing, same behaviour elsewhere in the product.

statutes.name: Statutes and standards
statutes.prompt: Consistent with laws, regulations and standards (consumer law, WCAG, PCI).
